description: Crawl one website from a start URL and get its pages as Markdown: same-site links only, up to `max_depth` hops (<= 3) and `limit` pages (<= 50). Pass `query` to rank the pages by relevance and return only their relevant passages. Costs $0.001 per page returned ($1 per 1,000).

exclude_paths.description: Regexes; never follow links whose path matches one.

include_paths.description: Regexes; only follow links whose path matches one, e.g. ["^/docs/"].

max_depth.description: Link hops from the start page (0-3, default 1).

query.description: Optional topic: ranks pages and prunes each to the relevant passages.

name: contextfetch_crawl
title: ContextFetch site crawl
